listings.title: Senior / Principal Materials Scientist, AI Safety
listings.description:
Your Impact at LILA

We're building a talent-dense, high-agency AI safety team at Lila that will engage all core teams within the organization (science, model training, lab integration, etc.), to identify and mitigate risks from scientific superintelligence while retaining the core scientific discovery capabilities of the stack. The initial focus of this team will be to build and implement a bespoke safety strategy for Lila, tailored to its specific goals and deployment strategies. This will involve technical safety strategy development, broader ecosystem engagement, safety-focused evaluations, safety systems to mitigate risks, and a research agenda that explores longer-term needs such as oversight of superintelligent scientific systems.

We are seeking a materials scientist to map risk across the material sciences domain: you will connect deep materials expertise with dual-use risk assessment to help safeguard increasingly capable scientific AI. You will investigate how advances in materials research could change harmful capabilities, including established and emerging threats.

What You'll Be Building

  • Map misuse risks by connecting material properties, processing and functional performance (across a range of materials domains) to harmful applications, including emerging or overlooked uses of scientific advances.
  • Assess how physical feasibility, processing complexity, manufacturing requirements and actors' resources affect the plausibility and likelihood of misuse, including which constraints AI could change.
  • Distinguish established capabilities, plausible future developments and weakly supported hypotheses, revising assessments as evidence changes across models, tools and automated laboratories.
  • Identify gaps in expertise, commission targeted scientific input with the expert-program team, and integrate specialist findings into a coherent assessment of the risk landscape.

Our work spans protein and nucleic-acid design, cellular systems and biological delivery; we welcome other specialisms that bring relevant scientific depth and risk judgment.

What You'll Be Building

  • Formulate and pursue original computational biology research questions relevant to safety, developing computational approaches and designing and running studies that generate new evidence about biological capabilities, risks and safeguards.
  • Build and update an integrated picture of risks, examining how capabilities across LLMs, specialized biological models, agents and automated laboratories interact within scientific workflows and change practical constraints.
  • Combine your research with literature, model assessments, experimental findings and expert input to judge biological feasibility, uncertainty and the significance of emerging capabilities

listings.title: Research Scientist / Research Engineer, Automated Safety
listings.description:
Your Impact at LILA

We're building a talent-dense, high-agency AI safety team at Lila that will engage all core teams within the organization (science, model training, lab integration, etc.), to identify and mitigate risks from scientific superintelligence while retaining the core scientific discovery capabilities of the stack. The initial focus of this team will be to build and implement a bespoke safety strategy for Lila, tailored to its specific goals and deployment strategies. This will involve technical safety strategy development, broader ecosystem engagement, safety-focused evaluations, safety systems to mitigate risks, and a research agenda that explores longer-term needs such as oversight of superintelligent scientific systems.

As scientific AI systems become more capable and autonomous, their safety assessment and safeguards must develop alongside them. At Lila Sciences, you will help build the research methods and tools that make this possible, so that more and more decision-enablers can be automated safely. This will move us closer to the vision of a safety and security apparatus that is robust to a fully autonomous scientific engine.

Your initial focus will be misuse: developing flexible and automated red-teaming approaches that test safety-relevant scientific capabilities and the robustness of safeguards. You will also contribute to safety automation beyond red teaming, helping the team evaluate, monitor and respond to risks across increasingly autonomous scientific workflows. You will own reusable research methods and assessment tools, working with mitigation engineers who implement protective mechanisms. listings.title: Partner-Manager:in Lernprogramme
listings.description: Worum es geht Mit Coachweave macht die Teachlume GmbH aus dem Wissen von Coaches, Trainer:innen und Berater:innen digitale Lernprogramme, die Menschen über Wochen begleiten. Produziert wird mit einer eigenen KI-Kette: Strukturvorschläge, Kurse, Bilder, Stimmen, Übersetzungen. Was die KI nicht kann: verstehen, was ein Coach wirklich braucht, beurteilen, ob ein Programm wirkt, und es so bauen, dass es sich trägt. Dafür suchen wir dich. Die Nachfrage wächst gerade schneller, als unser Gründer allein Gespräche führen kann. Was du machst Du führst Erstgespräche mit Coaches und findest heraus, was sie wirklich brauchen. Du prüfst, was unsere KI aus Gesprächen und Material erstellt (Strukturvorschläge, PDFs, Kurse), gibst ihr präzises Feedback und gibst frei, wenn es gut ist. Du besprichst die Ergebnisse mit den Partnern und entwickelst die Programme mit ihnen weiter. Du denkst Programme wirtschaftlich: Preis, Einstieg, Abo, Upgrade, und was Lernende dranhält. Nach dem Start schaust du, was funktioniert, und machst daraus die nächste Staffel. Was du mitbringst Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Beratung oder Partner- und Kundenbetreuung mit eigener Verantwortung, gern in Coaching, Weiterbildung, EdTech oder SaaS. Du arbeitest strukturiert mit vielen Beteiligten gleichzeitig und lässt nichts liegen. Du rechnest gern nach, ob ein Modell trägt. Du weißt, wie Menschen lernen und dranbleiben; Erfahrung in L&D ist ein Plus, den Rest lernst du bei uns. Du erkennst, wenn ein Text oder Konzept nicht trägt, und kannst genau sagen, warum. listings.description: ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé. L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission : la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé, la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR). Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’Unité de Formation et de Recherche (UFR) Mécanique. L’UFR de Mécanique a pour mission d’assurer la formation en mécanique des élèves du cursus ingénieur d’ENSTA, des élèves de masters de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, et la formation par la recherche d’étudiants français et étrangers au niveau master et doctorat. L’Unité développe également des activités de recherche dans le domaine de la mécanique des matériaux et des structures, de la mécanique des fluides, des vibrations et de l’acoustique. Ces activités sont réalisées grâce à un important parc expérimental de haut niveau en mécanique des solides et des fluides, tant pour l’enseignement que la recherche. Sur le campus de Brest, l’UFR de Mécanique compte une cinquantaine d’enseignants chercheurs, une cinquantaine de doctorants/post-doctorants ainsi qu’une dizaine de personnels techniques (ingénieurs, techniciens). Les activités de recherche des membres de l’UFR de Mécanique du site de Brest sont menées au sein de l’Institut de Recherche Dupuy de Lôme (IRDL, CNRS UMR 6027, www.irdl.fr ). La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les enseignants-chercheurs de l’ENSTA,

👐 About the team

Growth is part of the Revenue team. We build Alma's merchant acquisition engine: which merchants we target, how we find, identify and qualify them, how fast a qualified merchant reaches the right salesperson and, with lifecycle, how we convert, activate and retain them, in France and in our international markets.

We work AI-native, by design. Everyone in Growth works in Claude Code with a shared library of skills and connectors, a common repository that holds our workflow spec, our decision log and our merchant context, and a simple delivery lifecycle (Research → Spec → Plan → Build) where each stage ends with a human decision. listings.title: Lead Software Engineer
listings.description: Building the intelligence behind Solskin Are you a driven person who wants to make buildings come alive? We are Zurich Soft Robotics (ZSR), a Zurich-based startup developing Solskin – a climate-adaptive solar facade. Solskin is not just a PV system or a shading system; it’s an intelligent skin that uses weather and building data, occupant feedback, and AI algorithms to decide how the facade moves, so buildings stay comfortable, avoid overheating, and use energy as efficiently as possible. Solskin is already running on several buildings across Switzerland, with many more to follow. In this role, you own the software that makes that happen. You write the code that runs Solskin, keep it reliable in the field, and constantly improve it. You will also architect and lead our future sensor-to-data platform. Your focus is where software meets hardware, and the control and AI on top of it. You don't need to be a front-end specialist. What you will do This is a hands-on leadership position: you code every day. Own the full stack: You maintain and develop the whole software stack, from cloud and data management to user-facing applications, and from low-level embedded firmware to high-level AI controllers learning from users. listings.title: Embedded Software Engineer
listings.description: De uitdaging Onze klant ontwikkelt high-tech embedded systemen die extreem betrouwbaar, veilig en performant moeten zijn. Je werkt in een omgeving waar innovatie de standaard is en waar jouw code direct invloed heeft op hardware, sensoren, controllers en real-time verwerking. We zoeken engineers die met plezier de diepte ingaan: van low-level drivers tot robust architecture en van integratie tot performance-optimalisatie. Wat ga je doen? Als Embedded Software Engineer werk je via GradeMatch binnen een multidisciplinair engineeringteam dat software, elektronica en systeemarchitectuur combineert. Je ontwikkelt embedded software in C en C++, analyseert hardware-interactie, werkt met RTOS-omgevingen en draagt bij aan nieuwe en bestaande modules. Je krijgt te maken met complexe systemen, nieuwe productfeatures, protocollen, edge computing, testscenario’s en integratie met high-end apparatuur. Hoe je impact maakt Je implementeert embedded softwaremodules in C en C++ volgens hoge kwaliteitseisen en werkt aan drivers, interfaces, communicatiestromen en configuratiecomponenten. Je stelt duidelijke requirements op en denkt actief mee over designkeuzes, terwijl je samen met andere engineers high-level en low-level architectuurvoorstellen uitwerkt. Daarnaast test en review je code op betrouwbaarheid, performance en stabiliteit en werk je nauw samen met hardware engineers om een correcte integratie te waarborgen. Je begeleidt de live-gang, validatie en nazorg binnen de embedded omgeving en documenteert code, flows, architectuur en testresultaten zorgvuldig.
